head: Foreweek is a weekly planner for a few goals
dek: Foreweek asks what would make your week a success: you write a few goals, mark what matters most and tick them off. It was #45 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: No account or subscription; goals sync through iCloud. It costs $2.99 with in-app purchases, by Rahul Chowdhury.
means: If long to-do lists don't work for you, it keeps the week to a few goals.
todo: Find Foreweek in the App Store.
